content: Jesús, e-ambe-gakabo (12) e-sapin-bur-dummaganga-guega susad
Degi, Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadse (12) gochagua, ega gangued uksad, adi, niaburbamar onogega, dule-galagwensuli-gegumalad nudakega, degi, bela uellemalad nudakegarbar.
Jesús na e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-ambe-gakabogwad (12) weyob nugmalad:
Jesús-sapin-dummagan, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi sunmakapid
Jesús wemar, e-ambe-gakabogwad (12) barmisad, ega igar uksad: “Mer Judíoʼsurmaladse be namalo, degine, Samaria-neggweburmargi mer dogmarbalo.
Ar bur be Israel-dulemar sibad-wawaadyob-yoggus-gudimaladse be namaloed.
”Ar be nadmalale, Bab-Dummad-gayaburbagi be weyob sunmakmaloed: ‘Emigindi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid anmarse warmaksasunye.’
”Ar we-gangued manigi bemarga uklessursoggu, binsa bemar aimar-bendakmarmogoed, mer egi mani gamarmogo.
”Degine, olo, mani, esnon-mani, mer be sagu-yaba sedmalo.

Mordukwa amba igarba be sedosurmarbalid, amba mor gobo sedosurbalid, amba sapat-ogwaed satebar, amba gaapoled sedosurbar. Ar ade, dule-arbaedi na e-arbaedgi mas gunnergebed. Degisoggu, dulemarga be-ibmar-saoedi, a-dulemar masgi bemar-ogunnoed.
”Ar ibu-neggwebur-dummadse be dogdapdibe, neggwebur-bipigwadse be dogdapdibe, dule-nabir-be-sunmaked-abingaoed be amimaloed. A-neggi be a-neggweburgi-noedse be megmaloed.
Ar bemar a-negyase dogdapile, neg-ibedse be golo, ega sogo, bemar nued sogeye.
Ar a-negginmalad nued-egi-be-binsaed abingaele, a-negyagi dulemar neg-bogidikid ega nagunonikoed. Ar degisulirdi, neg-bogidikid nikuosulid.

”Ar dule-wargwen be-abingasulile, degine, be-sunmaked itosurbalile, a-neggindibe, a-neggweburgindibe, be nodagoed. Agi be noalile, be-naggi-olli-nanaid nue eli-eli be imakoed, oyogega, ese bemar bar dagosurye.
Napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad-igar-nabirogoed-ibagi, we-neggweburginmalad-be-abingassurmalad, Sodoma-neggweburginmaladba, degi, Gomorra-neggweburginmaladba bur bule sabsur odurdaklemaloed.”
Jesús bonigan-abargi e-sapingan-barmisad
Jesús, e-sapinganga sogded: “Emigi bemar, sibad-wawaadyob, achu-burburumalad-abargi an na be-barmidmar. Degisoggu, naibeyob bemar guagwar gudimaloed. Deginbali, baisursunna nuu-daeyob be damarbaloed.
Dulemargi nue salakarmar. Ar amar, Judío-dummagan-igar-nabiromaladga be-ukmaloed, degine, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggine, sabsur be-bibyomarbaloed.
Degine, ar be an-sapingan-gusoggu, dulemar, dummagan-negdakmamaid-asabin, degi, reymar-asabin be-ebipidmaloed, adi, dummaganga, degi, Judíoʼsurmaladga bemar angi sunmakmalagar.
”Ar dulemar a-dummaganga be-uksamalale, mer be bukib binsamalo, igi an sogodibeye. Ar be sunmak-sokalile, Bab bega binsaed ukoed, igi be sogoe.
Ar ade, bemar sunmakosulid, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled bemarba sunmakoed.”
Jesús, e-sapinganga sogdebalid: “Dulemar e-gwenadgan-oburgwega na muchub-muchub urmaknanai gumaloed. Bab na mimmigi aibinnai guoed. Mimmigan babgangi gwisgunanai gumogoed. Na oburgwenanai gumaloed.
Bemar an-sapingan-gumarsoggu, a-ular, bela dulemar isdar be-dakmaloed. Ar galakussurmaladdina, igar-bulegan-berguedse nue abonolemaloed.
”Ar neggwebur-gwensakgi be-bareginnarmalale, baid-neggweburse be idu wakinmalo. Ar napira an bemarga soged, amba yoo Israel-neggweburmar-bela-onoge, ani Dule-Machi, an danikoed.
”Ar bemar wisid, ar e-sailaba bur sapin dummadsulid, degine, e-ibedba bur mai dummadsurbalid.

Degisoggu, sapin e-sailayob-gusale bato gusbindo, degine, mai e-ibedyob-gusmogale, bato yeer itogewilubmodo. Ar dulemar an-annik sogmalad, ande Nia-Saila-Beelzebúʼye, ¿ar bemar-bursunna? Deyob bemarse gorlemarmogodo.”
Bab-Dummad bur be dobgumar

Jesús sogdebar: “Degisoggu, dule-isdar-be-dakmalad mer be dobgumar. Ar bipisaale ibmar-dukuar-imaklegedi, magadse buud noosurdeeye gwen soglesulid. Degi, ar emi amba ibmar-dukualed wisgulegosurdeeye gwen soglesurbalid. Ar wisgulegedsegad.
Ar begarbi an-ibmar-sogedi, bela dulemarga be sogmala. Ar unnila be uaya-nabarbi an bega ibmar-sogedi, bela dulemarga gatik be sogmaloed.
”Dulemar-be-oburgwebimalad, mer be dobgumar, ar be-burbadi oburgosurmalad. Bur Bab-Dummad be dobgumar, ar adi, sunna soo-sailagi dule-burba, degi, dule-san meted.
”¿Ar ade, sikwi-gwabo, esnon-gwagwengi uklesursi? Ar degite, sikwi-gwagwensaale napase be-Bab-sogsuli gwen argwanosulid.
Ar bemar-sailagiase-bakar, be-Bab-Dummad bela ebisar sediid.
Degisoggu, mer be dobgumar, ar bemar bur bule sikwimarba bur ibmar-nueganad.
”Ar doa-dule dulemar-asabin na sogdibe, ‘an Cristoʼba naiye,’ an-Bab-nibneggi-maid-asabin an sogmogodo, ‘we-dule an-sapinye.’
Ar doa-dule dulemar-asabin an-osulosardi, adi, an-Bab-nibneggi-maid-asabin an a-dule osulomogodo.”
Jesús-ular, dulemar muchub-muchub urwenai gumaloed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Mer be binsamalo, we-napnegse an neg-bogidik-saega an noniye. Neg-bogidik-saega an nonisulid. An nonikidi, urwed-onogega an nonikid.

content.text: ‘An nonikidi, dule na e-bab-ebo ourwega an nonikid,
bunagwa na e-nan-ebo ourwega an nonikid,
bala na e-saka-bundor-ebo ourwega an nonikid.

content: Miqueas 7:6
”Ar dule, an-sabedba bur bule e-bab-sabele, e-nan-sabele, we-dule an-sapinga gege gued. Ar dule an-sabedba bur bule e-bunagwa-sabele, e-machigwa-sabele, an-sapinga gege gued.
Igi dule burgwegala, nakrus semaidae, deyobi, dule guakwaa burgwega anba nanasulile, a-dule an-sapinga gege gued.
”Ar dule-wargwen na e-san-bendakedgi binsaele, e-san-burba ei berguoed. Ar anba-naid-ular, burgwenonikirdi, adi, e-san-burba bendaknonikoed.”
Bab-Dummad ibmar-nuegan ukoed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar dule bemar-abingaele, an-abinganaido. Ar dule an-abingaele, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialid-abinganaido.

Ar dule Bab-gayaburba-barsoged-abingaele, ar Bab-gayaburba-barsoged-ibmar-abingaeyobi, Bab-Dummad ega ibmar-nuegan ukmogoed. Degine, dule, dule-innikidaed-abingaele, ar dule-innikidaed-ibmar-abingaeyobi, Bab-Dummad ega ibmar-nuegan ukmogoed.”

Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar doa-dule dule-bipigwadga nog-gwagwen dii-diopigwad uksadibe, ar dule-bipigwad-an-sapingusoggu, napira an bemarga soged, Bab-Dummad ibmar-nuegan ega ukosurdeeye soglesurdo, ega ukedsedo.”
